Oneliner

Splits into two joined by a 1 km tether to test electrodynamic tether propulsion.
Description

Test the TEPCE tether deployment hardware in LEO and to analyze the dynamics during and after deployment. 3U CubeSat that splits into two 1.5U CubeSats joined by a 1 km tether to test electrodynamic tether propulsion.
